name: Host-side Bounding Box Computation
definition: Computes the bounding box for each triangle in a mesh on the CPU host. It calculates two arrays, `bbox0` (minima) and `bbox1` (maxima), where each triangle has its own bounding box defined by 3D coordinates.
summary: Host-side Bounding Box Computation calculates per-triangle axis-aligned bounding boxes on the CPU to prepare meshes for GPU voxelization, differing from global mesh bounds by maintaining individual primitive extents.
